prompt: Why is the churn model trained on 31 December 2024 and tested on 30 June 2025, rather than on a random half of the customers?

choices.text: A random split is not supported by scikit-learn for logistic regression, so a date had to be used
choices.why: It is supported; the reason is about honesty.

choices.text: It will be used on a future
choices.why: Right. The test should look like use.

choices.text: June has more customers
choices.why: Size is not the reason.

choices.text: To make the model look better than it would otherwise, which is acceptable for a first version
choices.why: A random split is the one that flatters.

prompt: At Panela, why should the business accept many false alarms?

choices.text: A missed churner costs far more than an offer
choices.why: Right. The cheaper mistake is the one to make more of.

choices.text: False alarms improve the model's next version

choices.text: The default threshold is too high
choices.why: That is a consequence, not the reason.

choices.text: Precision is not a meaningful measure
choices.why: It is; it is what the retention team sees.
